antigravity.channelNoticeBody: Uses Antigravity Hub User-Agent identity headers to connect directly to Google Cloud Code internal endpoints rather than the default DSH User-Agent. Requests consume your personal/workspace Google Code Assist quota.
antigravity.cacheColdDesc: Active account switched at {{time}} ({{reason}}). Your next turn may observe a temporary 0% prompt cache hit until the prefix warms on {{account}}.
antigravity.accountsDesc: Sticky per-session account affinity keeps KV prefix cache warm. Automatic switchovers occur only after 3 consecutive Auth/Quota/Rate-Limit failures or when pool quota drops to <= 5%.
antigravity.manualCallbackPlaceholder: Paste full http://127.0.0.1:.../oauth-callback?code=... URL if browser redirect cannot reach localhost
antigravity.quotaDesc: Live quota aggregated from Cloud Code internal summary and available models.
antigravity.quotaDegraded: Quota lookup unavailable (fail-open; model calls still allowed): {{error}}
antigravity.statsDesc: Disjoint input accounting (prompt minus cached tokens; self-computed totalTokens for DSH token meter).
antigravity.noTelemetry: No Antigravity turns recorded in this process yet.
antigravity.modelsDesc: Choose which Antigravity models appear in the DSH model picker.
antigravity.catalogSourceStatic: Source: Static Fallback (Refresh Quota to sync)
